snippet.title: Game "ASPIS" | Official trailer (English)
snippet.description:
ASPIS is a mystical thriller set in the Soviet era.
The action takes place in the Institute of Cybernetics in 1989.
The plot revolves around an advanced computing system created to model reality and predict the future, on which the country's top leadership has placed great hopes.
After several tests, scientists finally launch the ASPIS system, but the consequences are unpredictable.
Now is the institute empty or does it only seem empty at first glance? Reality is distorted, and behind every door there are secrets that should not have been revealed...

Add ASPIS to your Steam wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129420/ASPIS/
